english.title: Fishing vessel owner / skipper of a fishing vessel fails to ensure required food and drinking water
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[skipper]_

of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), failed to ensure that food and drinking water provided on board was suitable in respect of quality, quantity and nutritional value, did not contain anything likely to cause sickness, injury to health or to render it unpalatable and was otherwise fit for consumption
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 22(1) and (3) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the owner / skipper of a fishing vessel
failed to ensure that food and drinking water provided on board
was suitable in respect of quality / quantity / nutritional value AND

english.notes: Regulation 30 provides a defence for the person charged to show that all reasonable steps had been taken by that person to ensure compliance with the provision concerned.
